title: Andy Reid: Mia Bieniemy is improving every day, no timetable for Eric to return

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Andy Reid: Mia Bieniemy is improving every day, no timetable for Eric to return
sources.description: Mia Bieniemy, the wife of Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy, is improving after she was shot in their home in Virginia on July 26.
